docstring:
Erdős [Er46] asked whether every set of $n$ distinct points in $\mathbb{R}^2$
determines $\gg \frac{n}{\sqrt{\log n}}$ many distinct distances.
references: [Er46](https://doi.org/10.2307/2305092) Erdős, Paul. On sets of distances of $n$ points. Amer. Math. Monthly 53 (1946), 248--250.
[GuKa15](https://doi.org/10.4007/annals.2015.181.1.2) Guth, Larry and Katz, Nets Hawk. On the Erdős distinct distances problem in the plane. Ann. of Math. (2) 181 (2015), 155--190.
[Mo52](https://doi.org/10.2307/2307105) Moser, Leo. On the different distances determined by $n$ points. Amer. Math. Monthly 59 (1952), 85--91.
